name: Dr. Wonjoon Kim
summary: He formerly served as Acting Secretary General of the Korea Fair Trade Commission and as an Attaché at the Korean Delegation to the OECD.
highlights: Former Administrator at the Office of the President
Former official at the Economic Planning Board
Former Adjunct Professor, Sungkyunkwan University Law School and Sogang University Graduate School of Management of Technology
Ph.D in Economics, Paris 10 University
MPA, Seoul National University; BA in Economics, Sungkyunkwan University

name: Dr. SeongHo Jun
position: Professor at the Academy of Korean Studies
summary: He holds BA, MA, and Ph.D degrees in Economics from Sungkyunkwan University and researches economic and accounting history.
highlights: Visiting Professor at Goethe University Frankfurt
Researcher at the International Institute of Social History
Postdoctoral research at the University of Oxford
BA, MA, and Ph.D in Economics, Sungkyunkwan University

name: Dr. Vilayphone Somsamone
position: Dean of the Faculty of Economics and Tourism, Souphanouvong University
summary: She leads the university's Center for Korean Studies and researches sustainable tourism, regional development, and Korean studies.
highlights: Director of the Center for Korean Studies
Ph.D in Economics, Academy of Korean Studies, 2017

name: Dr. Zhang Wen
position: Center for Economic Research, Shandong University
summary: Her research interests include East Asian economic history, modern banking history, and traditional accounting in China and Korea.
highlights: Postdoctoral Researcher at SUSTech, Sep 2019 – Nov 2021
Former Researcher at the China Accounting Museum
Ph.D in Economics, Academy of Korean Studies, 2019

name: Dr. Gozal Shamuratova
position: Professor at Karakalpakstan National University and Senior Advisor to the Chair of the Supreme Council
summary: She researches transculturalism in Central Asia and Korea and advises on trade, investment, and economic relations with the Republic of Korea.
highlights: Senior Advisor on trade, investment, and economic relations with the Republic of Korea
Ph.D in Economics, Academy of Korean Studies, 2024

name: Dr. Le Lan Huong
position: Lecturer, Faculty of Business Administration, Saigon University
summary: She researches human resource development, workforce planning, business administration, and economic growth in Korea and Vietnam.
highlights: Comparative research on Korean and Vietnamese human resource development
Ph.D in Economics, Academy of Korean Studies, 2020
Doctoral thesis: “Human Resource Development in Korea and Vietnam: Focusing on Manpower Planning Reforms”

name: John O. Lee
summary: A civil engineering and construction executive in the United States, he founded ACE Engineering in 1987 and has led government and military construction projects.
highlights: BS in Civil Engineering, Sungkyunkwan University, 1980
Construction projects for U.S. federal, military, state, and local government clients
